Quote: Also, where do you get off talking to Yasuho all casual like that?! Anybody that talks to Yasuho like that is my enemy!

Name: Daiya Higashikata
Quote: Caaaaalifoooooorniaaaaa! I can take one of a person's memories...!

Name: Daiya Higashikata
Quote: I love you, Josuke. I'll always have your memory here with meee.. sharing them. One by one, lots of them, lots and lots... that happiness is my goal.

Name: Daiya Higashikata
Quote: If this is a call from Yasuho... then he can say goodbye... to these two chess pieces... and the concept... of his important things itself... I'll completely extinguish it from this world...

Name: Kei Nijimura
Quote: I can say this decisively... I'm sure of it. Your true identity is my older brother, Yoshikage Kira... there's no doubt about it. But that's only part of you. There's another person.

Name: Yotsuyu Yagiyama
Quote: I am a rock. I am an island.

Name: Yotsuyu Yagiyama
Quote: So you came all the way here... to die a second time...?

Name: Yotsuyu Yagiyama
Quote: Y... You're... just going to be... betrayed by the Higashikata family... anyway...

Name: Aisho Dainenjiyama
Quote: Damn! That's creepy... what fucked up birds... they're all looking this way.

Name: Aisho Dainenjiyama
Quote: This turned into something really dangerous... so the one tailing me and trying to investigate me was... hey! What the hell is going on here? Jobin Higashikata... that's your son!

Name: Elder A. Phex
Quote: It seems we won't be able to stay in this town long, either... but there's nothing to be ashamed of. It's not your fault. Because that is what I love about you most of all.

Name: Tsurugi Higashikata
Quote: Want something to drink? I have a lil' soy milk. And some cold cola.

Name: Tsurugi Higashikata
Quote: The Higashikata Family has believed in charms against evil spirits for generations... when the first son is born, he is dressed as a girl until he is 12 years old to trick the demons that cause disease. That happened to my dad, and grandpa, and his grandpa too.

Name: Tsurugi Higashikata
Quote: My ability is origami. My ability is that when my origami touches a person, that person loses the ability to tell faces and designs and things like that apart...

Name: Mitsuba Higashikata
Quote: Getting older is fine and all... but I can't let my nails get dirty or my breasts sag. After becoming the wife of the Higashikata Family, even if I'm a mom, I have to keep turning heads or it's all over for me.

Name: Mitsuba Higashikata
Quote: You know, back in my school days, I was Miss Cherry. Lelo. As the winner of a contest, I got to travel to China and Europe for the fruit of Japan. That's how I got to know my husband Jobin and ended up marrying into the Higashikata family. I was even a model for Higashikata Fruit Parlor ads. Moreso after I had Tsurugi than when I was younger. I had support from the whole family and it helped sales, too.

Name: Dolomite
Quote: The Blue Lagoon. Man, I'd love to really go there... that's my dream... To be shipwrecked, just the two of us clinging to wreckage and drifting together. We'd dive to catch fish, break open fruit from palm trees and build a tree house on an island... hpmh, though... I guess that's not all that realistic...

Name: Dolomite
Quote: This is a feeling I though I'd long forgot. That girl... I wonder how old she is now? Probably around 32-33? Maybe I could try inviting her again... to the Blue Lagoon...

Name: Urban Guerilla
Quote: Living organisms exist above rocks and soil. But once you meet your death, you exist below them. You people... when you got careless, you ended up being forever below the rocks... the Rock Humans, that is! Come get me!

Name: Poor Tom
Quote: Don't you get iiit?!! The closer you get ta me, the higher the pressure's gonna get!! You lost, jackass! Now go die, Josuke Higashikata!

Name: Poor Tom
Quote: This Stand can cordon off the area around the branch. Nobody'll even be able ta get close. My Stand is called Ozon Baby. It don't matter who it is, nobody'll be able ta get to any branch in that orchard.

Name: Wu Tomoki
Quote: I want to be clear about something... You all are the evil ones.

Name: Wu Tomoki
Quote: I must steer clear of any predictable failures. 100% of patients I accept are healed. All patients want to be 100% healed. And I make those desires come true.

Name: Hato Higashikata
Quote: Oh, my! Someone dropped a magazine with such a pretty girl on the cover in a place like this?! Gee, I'm sure I've seen this person before somewheeere... It's meeeee muhuhuhuhu!!

Name: Holy-Joestar Kira
Quote: Thank you. You did well to come here. You said your name is Yasuho-san, right...? Come again, okay?! Such a pretty girl... She... is already using "it" subconsciously, it looks like. But if she realizes how to use it, then... investigate the family tree. If she realizes that, she will give strength to my son... surely this is also Fate.

Name: Holy-Joestar Kira
Quote: The hospital director's form cannot be grasped... Yoshikage... you absolutely must not chase after him. But it's okay to make him do the chasing. Please... Be careful... Because I want... To see you... Again.

Name: Karera Sakunami
Quote: It was Kira's knowledge that hid me from the world, right? I promise I won't tell anyone, Josefumi Kujo-kun.

Name: Kaato Higashikata
Quote: These 15 years of success of the Higashikata Fruit Parlor are thanks to me, too. He may have divorced me while I was in jail, but I'm going to be compensated with money! Because I'm taking my life back. Otherwise, it wouldn't have been worth it.

Name: Kaato Higashikata
Quote: Shouldn't it be obvious I'd at least want to see my kids?!! I gave birth to every one of them! And I didn't do anything wrong. Back then... I swear on the souls of my ancestors that I did the right thing. But... you abandoned me... put me in jail... and divorced me!! I'm going to get compensated after all that.

Name: Yoshikage Kira (JJL)
Quote: This is a port. Ojiro Sasame... you say you're a surfer, but is that a job? Are you a man of the sea? Or a man of the land? Which is it? Be decisive!

Name: Yoshikage Kira (JJL)
Quote: She's just a stalker but... Stand abilities are connected in some way. That's what I'm getting at. We have some kind of fated connection.

Name: Yoshikage Kira (JJL)
Quote: You guys can't even figure out where the Locacaca branches are. You don't know shit. And you sure as hell can't predict my plan.

Name: Josefumi Kujo
Quote: I can't take it anymore... I'm always being abandoned... Nobody ever even pays any attention to me... I've worked so, so hard... but, it's always gone the same way. I just end up abandoned.

Name: Josefumi Kujo
Quote: Please... Save Holy. Eat it... break the curse... and we'll look up at a new sky.

Name: Lucy Steel (JJL)
Quote: I know it... That star-shaped birthmark on your shoulder... And I know... that we're connected by a mission. And while I can't see it with my eyes... I know that you have that power of the heart, a Stand!!

Name: Joseph Joestar (JJL)
Quote: They call me Fumi-kun.

Name: Joseph Joestar (JJL)
Quote: Let's get away from this place!! The Radio Gaga Incident wasn't just some made up story! Go call someone! We'll look for the driver with the police! I... I wanna go home!

Name: Jodio Joestar
Quote: It's probably because you were jamming out to Dua Lipa too hard

Name: Jodio Joestar
Quote: Everyone loves our mother. So mother is able to commute to the airport safely every day. That's because we brothers protect her.

Name: Jodio Joestar
Quote: Don't lay another hand on him! He's a mangaka! He may be a rich guy, but he's a special rich guy! I respect him. And I believe today's gonna turn out to be a great one.

Name: Dragona Joestar
Quote: Paco! Can you hear me? You'd better get the heck outta here before I wrap your ear around your head! Don't you dare mess with the customers in my shop! You asshole!

Name: Dragona Joestar
Quote: Be sure not to push yourself too hard, but don't give up.
